svg.title: Roundup and MN9: saved FlyWire neuron reconstructions
svg.desc: Exact saved skeletons for Roundup in violet and MN9 in teal, projected from shared FlyWire source X-Z coordinates. All selected branches retained. This shows neuron morphology, not activity or the effect of cutting outputs.
